brief:
A Palestinian child was wounded by Israeli army gunfire in the al-Sudaniya area near Gaza City, the Palestinian news agency Wafa reported. The shooting took place at a camp housing displaced people in the region.

The circumstances surrounding the incident remained unclear. No immediate statement was issued by the Israeli military regarding the incident, and details about the child's condition and the severity of injuries were not disclosed. The al-Sudaniya area has been a site of significant displacement during the ongoing conflict in Gaza.
